title: One grammar for each type
notes: With Chomsky’s numbering: a Type 3 grammar, a Type 2, a Type 1 and a Type 0. The last one is caught by its rule S → ε: an ε-rule is allowed in a context-sensitive grammar only for a start variable that never appears on a right side.
ops: S -> abc | aSBc; cB -> Bc; bB -> bb
S -> aSB | eps; aB -> Ba; B -> b
